headlines.title: Union Pacific Corp's Dividend Analysis
headlines.summary: Union Pacific Corp (NYSE:UNP) recently announced a total dividend of $1.42 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-31.  This includes a cash dividend of $1.42 per share, payable on 2026-09-30.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.

headlines.title: Union Pacific (UNP) is Winning the Railroad Race. Can Norfolk Southern (NSC) Catch Up through the Merger?
headlines.summary: On July 27, Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) and Norfolk Southern Corporation (NYSE:NSC) enhanced their joint merger application with expanded customer protections sent to the Surface Transportation Board (STB). Seeking to create the first single-line transcontinental network, the rails offered terms going beyond prior Class I combinations.

headlines.title: Union Pacific Corporation CEO Jim Vena and CFO Jennifer Hamann to Participate in Virtual Fireside Chat, Hosted by Bernstein Research
headlines.summary: OMAHA, Neb., August 27, 2026--Jim Vena, chief executive officer, and Jennifer Hamann, executive vice president and chief financial officer, of Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) will participate in a virtual fireside chat, hosted by Bernstein Research on Tuesday, Sept. 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. ET.

headlines.title: Union Pacific, Norfolk Southern defend rail merger application as STB review advances
headlines.summary: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern insist their merger application meets regulatory thresholds and urge the STB to proceed with the review. The post Union Pacific, Norfolk Southern defend rail merger application as STB review advances appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: 2 Dividend-Paying Stocks From the Railroad Industry to Consider
headlines.summary: Here we have picked two railroad stocks, UNP and CNI, which have a solid five-year dividend growth history.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
